Fang Zheng decreased its stake in Nvidia Corp (NVDA) by 0.7% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Keywise Capital Management Ltd sold 1,700 shares as the company’s stock rose 15.49% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Fang Zheng held 240,220 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $46.48 million, down from 241,920 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Keywise Capital Management Ltd who had been investing in Nvidia Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $154.58 billion market cap company.
